text: Loren ipsum, used as dummy or placeholder text for graphic design, publishing, and web development. Its purpose is to permit a page layout to be designed, independently of the copy that will subsequently populate it, or to demonstrate various fonts of a typeface without meaningful text that could be distracting.
The reason it came about is that in some old print of the book, one page ended with “quisquam est qui do-“ and the next page began with “-lorem ipsum"
so dolorem got cut in the middle of the word
